reviews.title: Nice and clean looking black rgb fans
reviews.comment: Nice fans. Good airflow, good noise level, and pricing is alright. Obviously you can tell these aren't no Lian-li's when holding them, all of these clone style or similarly looking fans feel cheaper compared to the premium brands, but the price to performance ratio is pretty darn good. Can't say much in regards to reliability, but will update if issues arise.
reviews.author: Kamran

reviews.title: Great look for a great price!
reviews.comment: There fans are a great budget option in the space, they work beautifully with signalRGB and are very simple to install, just like the older lian li fans before they went fully proprietary, love the look of these in my case, can't even see the fan blades. The color is accurate; and for $15 fans, they run very quiet and help keep my 7800x3d nice and cool
reviews.author: Ceddyrick

reviews.title: Half the price and worth it
reviews.comment: The fans I wanted (you know the ones) were out of stock so I decided to take a chance on these and I’m glad I did. For half the cost and not needing a controller, I got exactly what I wanted. FYI these are intake fans, so in the pictures attached, the air will blow into the case. They Daisy chain easily and I plugged them into the JARGB_V2 and SYS_FAN6 headers on my MSI mobo. Color control is done via mystic light. Mystic light was a bit buggy, i could only set the color when commanding all devices, it would not work when specifying just that header. Also color accuracy isn’t great with mystic light if you use the dropper, you need to specify the RGB values themselves. Fans very quiet with the case open. They can spin up with a decent amount of noise when going full speed but that hasn’t happened even when playing BF2042 on ultra settings for hours so I don’t think it’s something to worry about. Fans themselves feel quality and the user guide for setting them up is actually useful and straightforward.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Amazing fans!
reviews.comment: The asiahorse dawn is the perfect low-key RGB fan :) I love that its not super flashy, looking more refined if anything. NOTE: On rgb softwares, the coloring is a bit off. other than that, it is of amazing build quality, runs super quiet, and it produces great airflow, all under the crazy prices of other fans.
reviews.author: Derek T

reviews.title: Quiet. Aesthetic. Easy installation.
reviews.comment: I wanted to get the lian li at first I love their design. But... tbh $300+ for a 10 pack is just not worth it just for fans. I've decided to go with these and I was hesitant at first, I got em, easy installation (had to get a $10 argb hub) and they look amazing and work amazing. They are quiet, argb looks beautiful and again they were so easy to install into my Lian Li O11D EVO RGB E-ATX The only thing that I did not liked at all is that, I got the pack of 3 reversed fan and they don't look the same as in the pictures. As you can see my build is fully black and these reversed blade had white fans but the case of it is black. And they got the infinity signature in the center too.  I didn't wanted to replace them because also they don't have more in stock and honestly doesn't look too bad at all.
